study.design: Field sampling of milled and pounded maize and millet flour with health risk assessment
study.origin: Grain from 10 communities in the Tolon District, Northern Region, Ghana
study.market: Popular corn-milling stations (commercial milling sites) in the communities
study.period_text: First and second weeks of March 2019
study.method: H2SO4 digestion with catalyst; AAS (Varian Spectra 220 FS)

unresolved: Results basis not stated (samples oven-dried 30 min before digestion).
Digestion used H2SO4 with catalyst tablets; no detection limits, recoveries or reference materials are reported.
Cd, As and Hg were not measured.
Control means other than those printed in the text are figure-only.
The near-identical Pb means and very small Pb SDs across 10 communities are unusual for flame AAS near the reported levels; noted, not flagged.
